test_title: PYST 45: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting in a row, facing north. Only three people sit between A and B. R sits to the immediate left of B. No one sits to the right of D. Only two people sit between D and R. C sits to the immediate right of S. How many people sit between Q and C?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, Q, R and S are sitting in a row, facing north. 

1) No one sits to the right of D. 

2) Only two people sit between D and R. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/206fcffbe028a44a01377dfd2f56da4052843931199d519720feb8421bdee4b0.png] 

3) R sits to the immediate left of B.

4) Only three people sit between A and B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4154160b067f3b778242afb008b883e2cd1b12c8b95d11907c529d77b2311f1f.png] 

5) C sits to the immediate right of S. 

After positioning C and S only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efc47506e66c734d0e44ff28ebd3d86d9db1ea1e9d3ab2d99ae07a4a30f7fe92.png] 

Thus, two people sit between Q and C.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
